notes.title: Back Us on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
🎮 Attention Gamers! 🎮

We're thrilled to announce that we're heading to Kickstarter, and we want you to be a part of this journey.

🌟 What's in store? 🌟

🚀 We're working on a game that we're genuinely passionate about. It's a unique experience, designed to engage your imagination with a compelling story, captivating visuals, and immersive gameplay.

💡 Why Kickstarter? 💡

We believe in the power of the gaming community. Kickstarter allows us to connect directly with you, the players, and make our vision a reality. Your support will help us bring Keltika to life, and you'll have a direct impact on its development.

🙌 How can you get involved? 🙌

Stay Tuned: Keep an eye on our social media for updates about the Kickstarter campaign's launch date.

Spread the Word: Tell your friends, family, and fellow gamers about our project. The more people who know, the better!

Support Us: When the Kickstarter campaign goes live, consider pledging your support. We've got some fantastic rewards and perks lined up for our backers.

Share Your Ideas: We value your input. Join the conversation, share your ideas, and be a part of the development process.

🌐 Follow Us 🌐

🚀Back Us on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rainymaystudio/keltika]Kickstarter[/url]
💬Join Our Community on [url=https://discord.gg/y4NFRdCy]Discord[/url]
📢Follow Our [url=https://twitter.com/RainyMayStudio]Twitter[/url]
📺Watch Our Videos on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@RainyMayStudio]Youtube[/url]

Connect with us on social media, join our newsletter, and stay in the loop. Your support means the world to us, and together, we'll make this game a reality!

The future is exciting, and it's coming to Kickstarter soon. Join us on this incredible journey!

Stay tuned for more updates and let's bring this game to life. Together, we can make it happen!

#KeltikaOnKickstarter 🎮✨

notes.title: UPDATE v0.2
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who helps us find and fix issues with the demo! If you're having problems running the game, please don't hesitate to reach out!

[h1]TUTORIAL MODE[/h1]

After a couple of very productive and challenging weeks we are very excited to present you our brand new Tutorial Mode!

We had a lot of feedback asking for some kind of guide to the game's rules and interface, and today we have finally polished it enough to add it with the latest update.

Also we worked really hard to fix common known issues to make the game more stable.

We at Rainy May Studio hope that you'll have a great time in Keltika!

notes.title: Keltika Demo Released
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478060/Keltika/

We are glad to present a demo version of Keltika.
You can install it from Keltika's Steam page.
Don't forget to add Keltika to your wishlist - it's totally free and will help us in our work on a full version!
Any feedback is much appreciated.
Thank you for being a part of our journey.
